Name: Meal Time
Author: XnixnBvg
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][center][size=6]UPDATE: Okay, so I got lost in the making of this mod, I lost access to this account because I didn't know my email (thankfully I managed to get back in due to quick thinking and because I saved my password.) I have updated it with 2 more variants, PLEASE CHOOSE ONE![/size]

Do you use Survivalist?
Are you tired of losing your godamned mind every day each week?
Are you sick of waiting for Gus to open at 12PM sharp while trying to get grub to fill up your hunger bar and thirst meter?

Then this is the mod for you! 

Meal Time enables you to buy a preselected meal all within Pierre's shop! This is to be used with the survivalist mod which is why its a requirement. Enjoy!~[/center][/font]
